data.name: Mercure Salvador Pituba
data.address: Av. Prof. Magalhães Neto, S N - Pituba, Salvador - BA, 41819-011, Brazil
data.description:
This modern, high-rise hotel in a business district is 3 km from Armação Beach on the Atlantic Ocean, 4 km from Estádio Parque Santiago stadium and 5 km from the Fiesta Convention Center.
The upscale rooms in neutral tones feature free Wi-Fi, flat-screen TVs and minibars, as well as work desks, safes, and tea and coffeemakers. Room service is available.
Amenities include a casual restaurant with terrace dining, and a lobby bar featuring live music. There's an outdoor pool, an exercise room and a business center. Conference facilities are available. Parking and a breakfast buffet are offered for a fee.
